arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/storage/worktree.ts'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('/** The untracked files a stash holds that are not on disk yet')
j=s.index('/**\n * `git stash apply --index`, else')
s=s[:i]+'''/** Back to the checkout the run started with: the original HEAD, no changes, no untracked files (ignored ones stay). */
async function startClean(
	cwd: string,
	original: { head: string; branch: string | undefined },
): Promise<void> {
	await git(cwd, ["reset", "--quiet", "--hard"]).catch(() => undefined);
	await git(cwd, [
		"checkout",
		"--quiet",
		"--force",
		original.branch ?? original.head,
	]).catch(() => undefined);
	await git(cwd, ["clean", "--quiet", "-fd"]).catch(() => undefined);
}

'''+s[j:]
s=s.replace('''	const added = await newUntracked(cwd, record.stash).catch(() => []);
''','')
s=s.replace('await startClean(cwd, original, added);','await startClean(cwd, original);')
s=s.replace(' * Restore a snapshot into the checkout at `cwd` (which should be clean)',' * Restore a snapshot into the checkout at `cwd`, which must be clean (no changes, no untracked files)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "Restore a snapshot" -A5 src/storage/worktree.ts; grep -n "isClean\|before.indexTree" -A4 src/worktree.ts | head -20
